_about: Chunk 0.2: every mod the Argonia profile installs, in load order, grouped (core, combat, traversal, soul-ui, land, pipeline, dev). Files are downloaded to ~/.argonia/mods by infra/gpu-box/stack.py and never committed (decision 0003). profile: play (laid into Data), dev (laid only with --dev; never shipped), pipeline (fetched for the asset pipeline, never laid raw). set: a named alternative inside a group; the profile chooses one set per group (stack.py --set), with exact undo. sha256 is the downloaded archive's; stack.py verify checks it and the installed files' hashes.
